items.item: A `--fast` or `--slow` list that starts with a minus sign, written as two words

adversarial reviewer says park: plan.md Order of work step 1 has a wrong expected value in a planned test: it says `count_pairs([5, 50], [10, 50]) == (1, 3)`, but under R5 (and the plan's own `bisect.bisect_right(slows, fast)` per fast) the grid is (5,10) kept, (5,50) kept, (50,10) skipped, (50,50) skipped, so the answer is (2, 2). A correct count_pairs fails this test. A build that writes the test first, as the plan says, would either bend count_pairs to match, which breaks the skip count in the run line and the 400-pair cap, or change the expectation on its own. Fix: expect (2, 2), or keep (1, 3) with inputs that give it, e.g. `count_pairs([10, 50], [5, 20]) == (1, 3)`.
